warnings: Truss labels: T1 on grids 2, 3, 4 and 5 (steel trusses, ขยายโครงหลังคา T1 on sheet 3) and T2 on the gable ends, grids 1 and 6 (ขยายคานรับแปด้านสกัด (T2) on sheet 3 — an RC gable frame, not a steel truss). Both span the 10.00 width plus the 1.60 eaves (A' to D''). The T2 entries record the printed frame label only: the members of that frame are the R1 segments and the ครีบ ค.ส.ล. cantilevers listed separately in this file, so T2 is not an extra member.

R1 is printed three times along grid 1 and three times along grid 6 (A-B, just below the ridge in B-C, C-D) and is the sloped beam of the T2 gable frame (sheet 3: ขยายคาน R1 0.15 x 0.35, the same 2-Ø12 / ป-Ø6@0.20 callouts as the T2 elevation). It rises to the ridge line (แนวสันหลังคา, dummy B' at 5.00) and changes direction there, so the B-C bay is split at B' (section 5); the two 1.50 halves are scaled_from_grid because no tick is printed at the ridge. All R1 spans are plan projections of sloped members.

The thick gable-beam line continues over the 1.60 eaves at both ends of grids 1 and 6. Sheet 3's ขยายครีบ ค.ส.ล. shows that cantilever (the sloped R beam continuing past the column, with a 0.08 fin) — recorded as four unmarked segments (element_id null, element_name_assigned 'ครีบ ค.ส.ล.').

Grid 5 (the partition between the hall and the three rooms of bay 5-6) carries B1 in A-B, B-C (label just below the ridge line) and C-D: the คานทับหลัง B1 over the three roller doors (ประตูเหล็กม้วน, section ก-ก), at door-head level +2.45 although it is drawn on this roof plan.

Rows B and C between grids 5 and 6 carry a stacked label 'B/B1' (B over B1). Read as two beams on the same line — the คานทับหลัง B (0.07 x 0.25; the floor-plan note says the perforated block above the lintel runs up to 'ท้องคาน B', and section ก-ก labels 'คาน B' at the top of these partitions) and a B1 below it. Both are recorded as separate segments with a lowered score; the drawing does not say more.
R2 (sheet 3: 0.10 x 0.20) runs along rows A and D across bay 5-6 (the outer walls of the three rooms).

The front and rear elevations (side_profile, not extracted) also print B1 over the three gable-end openings of grid 1 and over the side bays of grid 6 (with a B over the rear window). No plan places those lintels, so they are not recorded as plan segments here.

Purlins (แปเหล็ก ⊏-100x50x20x3.2 @0.90-1.00) are not drawn on this plan; they are specified in the truss section file. Columns are drawn as small squares; they are recorded once in the footing-plan file.
